title: Provenance: machine fields first, explanatory note second
summary: Authority comes from structured artifact identity, SHA-256, member and optional line range. `note` is opaque explanatory prose and must never be parsed to recover the citation.

canonical_provenance.claim: optional claim supported by this evidence

invariants: Never reconstruct member/line authority from note prose.
A funny, confused or malformed note does not invalidate otherwise correct structured provenance.
Invalid SHA/member/line structure is a validation failure even if the prose sounds convincing.
